description: This file defines the IDGeneratorDao class responsible for managing unique identifier generation for specific entities within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to fetch the current ID and update to the next ID, utilizing Doctrine's QueryBuilder for database operations.

classes.name: IDGeneratorDao
classes.description: DAO class for generating and updating unique IDs for entities in the OrangeHRM system, extending the BaseDao.

methods.name: getCurrentID
methods.description: Retrieves the last ID used for a specified entity class, returning 0 if none exists.

methods.name: updateNextId
methods.description: Updates the 'lastId' for a specified entity class to the next ID.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Private helper method that retrieves the table name for a given entity class.
